verdict: DEGENERATE (negative). The absolute light-deflection coefficient is exactly -4, dimensionless and independent of a (F107 L4a), so it adds no constraint on a; the F83 (a, m_lat) ray is unbroken. A dimensionless observable cannot fix a length (scale-invariance theorem). The scale is pinned only by a dimensionful gravitational input: G (equivalently ell_P), via F79 a=sqrt(8pi)3^(1/4) ell_P. Mass-independent pin EXISTS but is the F79 G-match, NOT the lensing route the follow-up proposed.
